blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No ticket holder hit the jackpot in the Super Lotto 6/49 and Lotto 6/42 draws on Thursday, November 12, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. Super Lotto 6/49 draw result: 44-23-35-13-03-21 Jackpot prize: ₱103.36 million Lotto 6/42 draw result: 15-39-42-38-35-36 Jackpot prize: ₱15.86 million. The 6D Lotto draw produced the winning combination 4-1-7-4-4-1 for a jackpot of ₱7.98 million. No ticket holder won the top prize.
